children: Oscar Health boosted its full-year guidance for earnings from operations ahead of its investor day.

The health insurer, which focuses on individuals and small businesses, on Wednesday said it now forecasts earnings from operations of around $600 million to $800 million, up from its previous guidance of $500 million to $700 million.

Oscar also guided for a medical loss ratio--a measure of the proportion of premiums that the insurer pays out on medical claims--between 81% and 82%, an improvement from its prior guidance of 81.5% to 82.5%.
The company backed its prior forecast for revenue of around $18.7 billion to $19 billion for the year.
